sb_exist: Existence of state-based organized violence within country borders in a given year; 1 if it occurs.
sb_total_deaths_best: Best estimate for total fatalities in state-based violence within country borders in a given year.
ns_exist: Existence of non-state violence within country borders in a given year; 1 if it occurs.
ns_total_deaths_best: Best estimate for total fatalities in non-state violence within country borders in a given year.
os_exist: Existence of one-sided violence within country borders in a given year; 1 if it occurs.
os_total_deaths_best: Best estimate for total fatalities in one-sided violence within country borders in a given year.
cumulative_total_deaths_in_orgvio_best: Best estimate for cumulative total fatalities in organized violence within country borders.
